vulnerabilities.name: Potentially Dangling Subdomain: www.ef.competition.am
vulnerabilities.evidence_poc: DNS resolution failed for 'www.ef.competition.am', which was discovered via passive Certificate Transparency log enumeration. This may indicate a dangling DNS record vulnerable to subdomain takeover if a CNAME still points to an unclaimed third-party resource.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Manually verify the DNS record for this subdomain. Remove the record if it is unused, or reclaim/reconfigure the referenced third-party resource if still in use.

vulnerabilities.name: Exposed Sensitive File: /.DS_Store
vulnerabilities.evidence_poc: HTTP 200 OK response received for '/.DS_Store' with non-empty body content.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Remove or restrict public access to '/.DS_Store' via web server configuration or access control rules.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing Security Header: Content-Security-Policy
vulnerabilities.remediation: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) header allows a broader attack surface for injection-based attacks such as XSS.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing Security Header: Strict-Transport-Security
vulnerabilities.remediation: Missing HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header exposes users to SSL-stripping / downgrade attacks.

vulnerabilities.name: Missing Security Header: X-Content-Type-Options
vulnerabilities.remediation: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header allows browsers to MIME-sniff responses, which can lead to content-type confusion attacks.

informational_observations.name: Public robots.txt Detected
informational_observations.evidence: HTTP 200 OK response received for '/robots.txt' with non-empty body content.
informational_observations.remediation: No action required; this is a standard, benign publicly served file and its presence is not a vulnerability.
